Assessment strategy

Use the permitted dictionary and your hour well

Apply the sample guidance on dictionary use, task order and 15-minute guide times.

Official sources checked: 2026-09-19

Know what is permitted

The current sample assessor pack allows a monolingual simplified dictionary or glossary for reading tasks. Your centre's current instructions control on assessment day.

Do not look up every word

Use context first. A dictionary is most useful when one key word blocks the question or changes the required action.

01PURPOSE02CLUE03EVIDENCE04ANSWER

Protect time for all tasks

Use 15 minutes per task as a guide. Mark a difficult item, continue, and return only if time remains.

Answer the reading question

The assessment targets reading, not perfect spelling. The sample marking guidance says spelling is not penalised when meaning is clear, but the answer still needs to communicate the correct meaning.
